ficha_publicada.complicacoes: Arrogance: Brainiac 5 is condescending towards and often dismissive of people of lesser intellect. Guilt by Association: Brainiac 5 seeks to redeem the name of Brainiac and atone for the actions of the villains to bear the name. Instability: Brainiac 5 is prone to bouts of temporary insanity and mental breakdowns. These can occur due to extreme stress or from outside influence.
